label: The keyed trigger lane has no lines to classify: a lookup result is matchClass, path, phrases and score, so sweet-search's line-class mechanism has no surface in the Gate 1 lane.

Keyed-lane boilerplate enters only as declared frontmatter phrases, and no per-phrase quality class is persisted in the index (schema v2 stores paths and phrases only); judging all 42211 committed phrases found 230 negative-class phrases (0.54%), 409 of 17653 documents owning at least one, and 30 documents reachable only through boilerplate.

Real query 'acceptance criteria closure gate' ranked three acceptance-criteria template copies at query-containment 0.88 in slots 3-5, above a real packet at token-overlap 0.75, because template-default phrases are indexed and the judge only warns rather than deletes.

The free-text lane is where boilerplate floods: the stock sentence 'This document decides whether the packet may close' matched 784 files at exit 0 and every ranked row was classified body, while the literal FILL marker occurs only once per template example file and not across authored packets.

The match-class component is degenerate for fixed-string matches: rankMatches scores the matched line text against the query, so every hit contains the query, lands in the same class, and the sort falls through to evidence field, path and line.

The sweet-search mechanism does not transfer: its classes need a code-graph entity list plus an index-freshness gate, i.e. a persistent per-file symbol index that the topic bans and Markdown cannot supply; only the selection principle (prefer structural lines, demote boilerplate, one per section) transfers.

A Markdown line-class sub-order inside body is cheap to build in the free-text lane because rankMatches already reads the whole file per path for frontmatter ranges, so heading and table-row preference plus boilerplate demotion needs no new IO, index or dependency.
The keyed lane's artifact shape (schema v2: paths and phrases only) admits no line-level or per-phrase-quality signal; any such change is a schema bump, not a ranker tweak.
Every recommendation must remain stateless and index-free beyond the committed trigger index: no embeddings, no vector or BM25 fusion, no MCP, no daemon, no persistent index.
